header.title: A peaceful cabin community in the heart of Fjord Norway.

aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.text_part_1: Welcome to Hov Hyttegrend, a small and peaceful cabin community in the heart of beautiful Fjord Norway, surrounded by mountains, waterfalls, fjords, and glaciers. Here, you have a natural starting point for experiencing some of the very best Vestland has to offer, with calm surroundings, fresh air, and stunning scenery right outside your door. We are located close to the protected Gaular Watercourse, a unique river landscape known for waterfalls, rapids, and quiet mountain lakes winding through the valley, creating both beautiful nature experiences and great fishing opportunities.
aboutPage.text_part_2: With us, you can stay simply and comfortably in cabins, or with a motorhome or caravan at our spacious pitches close to nature. We have capacity for 15–20 motorhomes and caravans, and we focus on a calm, family-friendly atmosphere where guests can truly relax. Birdsong and the sound of the river are a natural part of your stay, and you are just a short distance from hiking trails, fishing waters, and local activities.
aboutPage.text_part_3: In our service building, you will find everything you need for a practical and pleasant stay: reception and kiosk, free WiFi, dishwashing kitchen, toilets and hot showers, as well as a laundry room with washing machine and tumble dryer. You can also get information about hikes, experiences, and attractions in the local area, making it easy to plan your days.
aboutPage.text_part_4: Hov Hyttegrend is also an excellent base for fishing and outdoor life. In the surrounding area, you will find several lakes and rivers with healthy trout stocks, and you can fish with both fly and lure. We offer fishing permits, boat and canoe rental, fishing gear for loan, and useful tips on where to find the best fishing spots.
aboutPage.text_part_5: If you enjoy hiking, Hov Hyttegrend is in the middle of an area with many opportunities all year round. You have direct access to the popular Fossestien trail – a 21 km route with waterfalls, lakes, and varied nature – and a short distance to Jostedalsbreen, Sognefjord, and several national parks. The area also offers lush cultural landscapes, active summer mountain farming, good opportunities for berry and mushroom picking, and scenic road trips to well-known attractions in the region.
aboutPage.text_part_6: Hov Hyttegrend is ideal for couples, families, anglers, and nature lovers who want a true West Norway experience with silence, peace, and grand nature – without crowds. Here, nature is close, everyday life feels far away, and it is easy to feel welcome.
